simple.meaning: שִׁרְיוֹן (Shiryôwn) is a Hebrew word meaning “Shirjon or Sirjon , a peak of the Lebanon.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: שִׁרְיוֹן (H8303) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Deuteronomy 3:9, with occurrences in Deuteronomy, Psalms.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שִׁרְיוֹן (H8303) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in שִׁרְיוֹן (H8303) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: שִׁרְיוֹן (Shiryôwn) / H8303 is traced through Deuteronomy 3:9, Psalms 29:6 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
